description: **Backfill edge for out-of-band completions.** The guard enforces two claims through one gate: "did this really ship" (server-verified commit + attested tests — reality) and "did this follow the process" (server_file_exists on design/blueprint/plan — procedure). For out-of-band work the first is checkable and the second is false by definition, so failing it blocks recording a true completion — the guard forces the roadmap to lie. Already cost us once: COMP-MCP-ENFORCE-XREPO records that the STRAT-AGENT-INTERP backfill "had to set status COMPLETE via direct feature.json edit". Adds a `complete_backfilled` terminal state (a distinct node, so it carries its own edge predicates — the guard keys predicates by from->to alone) reachable from any non-terminal phase, gated on UNWEAKENED reality evidence plus a mandatory written reason, with attested backfill of intermediate phases so partial walks become representable. Phase history gains a transaction-time axis (`recordedAt`/`origin`/`confidence`, vocabulary borrowed from SmartMemory's MemoryItem) since `enteredAt`/`exitedAt` already encode valid time. Design COMPLETE @919c02e after two Codex gates, nine findings, all confirmed. **BLOCKED on stratum:** guardMigrate (transition.ts:565,592) requires STRATUM_GUARD_OVERRIDE_TOKEN and unconditionally bumps graph_version, so migrating the 31 already-registered guard resources would make this feature depend on the emergency token it exists to replace. Owner declined a Compose-only v1 covering the ~319 unregistered features (of 350) because a completion path that silently fails on the oldest 31 reintroduces the defect class being removed. Order: stratum idempotent non-emergency migrate first, then this with no carve-out. Three Compose-side pieces still to redo before implement: phaseOrder is not a valid temporal insertion order (backward loops verification->blueprint, test->fix), cross-mutation recovery between the guard and vision-state, and reader changes. **RECONCILED 2026-09-05 — stratum blocker CLOSED.** The 2026-08-17 re-diagnosis (compose c7cc848) found the real blocker was the transport, not guardMigrate: compose reaches the guard over the CLI, where the override token was caller-mintable. Stratum shipped STRAT-GUARD-AUTHZ @3647b4c the same day (option ii, signed sshsig authorization over a server-reconstructed payload; override token removed; trust root ships EMPTY) and STRAT-GUARD-UPGRADE @91a55ed (token-free idempotent per-resource upgrade; `terminal` frozen by design, so complete_backfilled still needs one signed migrate per resource). Nothing remains on stratum. Compose-side work to do: enrol a signing key in stratum's trust root, generate + review the upgrade descriptor file, then the three redo items (phaseOrder is not a temporal insertion order; guard<->vision-state cross-mutation recovery; reader changes), then implement. Status BLOCKED->PLANNED.
